title: CERN 大型強子對撞機~CERN Large Hadron Collider
focus: 27 km 超導對撞機的磁剛度、亮度、1.9 K 低溫、機器保護與試運轉工程~Magnetic rigidity, luminosity, 1.9 K cryogenics, machine protection and commissioning of a 27 km superconducting collider
summary: 從磁剛度與亮度公式出發，理解為何 7 TeV 的質子需要 8.33 T 的 NbTi 偶極磁鐵與 1.9 K 超流氦，再把 362 MJ 的束流能量、準直與淬火保護、軌道與光學量測、注入與加速週期整合成一條可交接給操作團隊的對撞機工程鏈。~Start from magnetic rigidity and the luminosity formula to see why 7 TeV protons need 8.33 T NbTi dipoles and 1.9 K superfluid helium, then integrate the 362 MJ stored beam energy, collimation and quench protection, orbit and optics measurement, and the injection and ramp cycle into a collider engineering chain that can be handed to the operations team.

units.anchor: 26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵~26.7 km ring and main dipoles
units.title: 磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑~Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius
units.mechanism: 帶電粒子在磁場中的彎轉由磁剛度 Bρ = p/q 決定，對質子而言 Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]。LHC 沿用 LEP 的 26,659 m 隧道，彎轉只能由 1232 顆磁長 14.3 m 的主偶極磁鐵提供，因此彎轉半徑被固定在約 2804 m，要把質子推到 7 TeV 就必須有 8.33 T 的偶極場，這遠超過鐵磁飽和的 2 T，只能靠超導線圈。對撞機的優勢在質心能量：兩束 7 TeV 對撞得到 √s = 14 TeV，而 7 TeV 質子打固定靶只有 √(2Em) ≈ 115 GeV。~Bending of a charged particle in a magnetic field is governed by the magnetic rigidity Bρ = p/q, which for protons reads Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]. The LHC reuses the 26,659 m LEP tunnel, and all bending comes from 1232 main dipoles of 14.3 m magnetic length, so the bending radius is fixed near 2804 m; reaching 7 TeV therefore demands a dipole field of 8.33 T, far beyond the 2 T saturation of iron and achievable only with superconducting coils. The collider's advantage is centre-of-mass energy: two 7 TeV beams give √s = 14 TeV, whereas a 7 TeV proton on a fixed target yields only √(2Em) ≈ 115 GeV.
units.model: Bρ = 3.3356×7000 = 23,349 T·m；ρ = 1232×14.3 m/(2π) = 2804 m；B = 23,349/2804 = 8.33 T。Run 3 的 6.8 TeV 對應 8.09 T。固定靶的質心能量 √(2×7000 GeV×0.938 GeV) = 114.6 GeV，比對撞的 14,000 GeV 小 122 倍。這說明對撞機設計必須用超導磁鐵在固定隧道內提高彎轉磁場，而非只提高束流能量。~Bρ = 3.3356×7000 = 23,349 T·m; ρ = 1232×14.3 m/(2π) = 2804 m; B = 23,349/2804 = 8.33 T. The 6.8 TeV of Run 3 corresponds to 8.09 T. The fixed-target centre-of-mass energy √(2×7000 GeV×0.938 GeV) = 114.6 GeV is 122 times smaller than the 14,000 GeV of collisions. This is why a collider in a fixed tunnel must raise the bending field with superconducting magnets rather than raise beam energy alone.
units.verify: 用偶極磁鐵的旋轉線圈磁量測資料（每顆磁鐵在 1.9 K 的傳遞函數，單位 T/kA）乘上運轉電流，加總 1232 顆的彎轉角是否恰為 2π；再由束流的迴旋頻率 11,245 Hz 與 RF 頻率反推軌道長度，與 26,659 m 比較，差異應在毫米等級。~Multiply each dipole's rotating-coil transfer function at 1.9 K (in T/kA) by the operating current and check that the 1232 bending angles sum to exactly 2π; then infer the orbit length from the 11,245 Hz revolution frequency and the RF frequency and compare with 26,659 m, where the difference should be at the millimetre level.
units.failure: 若磁鐵傳遞函數的校正偏差 10⁻³，所有偶極同向多彎，束流中心能量與 RF 鎖定的軌道長度不再一致，束流被迫沿徑向偏移以補償，最終撞上孔徑或在加速中失去。~A 10⁻³ calibration error in the dipole transfer function makes every dipole over-bend in the same direction; the beam's central energy no longer matches the RF-locked orbit length, the beam shifts radially to compensate and is eventually lost on the aperture or during the ramp.
units.misconception: 只要隧道夠長，用普通電磁鐵也能達到 7 TeV。~With a long enough tunnel ordinary electromagnets could reach 7 TeV.

units.anchor: 亮度公式與對撞點 β*~Luminosity formula and β* at the interaction point
units.title: 亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽~Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*
units.mechanism: 對撞機的產率由亮度決定：事件率 = L×σ。對於 n_b 個團、每團 N 個質子、迴旋頻率 f_rev、正規化發射度 ε_n、對撞點 β 函數 β* 的高斯束，L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F，F 是交叉角造成的幾何損失因子。亮度隨每團粒子數平方上升，所以注入鏈必須提供高亮度的團，同時 β* 要由最後一組三合一超導四極磁鐵壓到次公尺等級。對撞點束流尺寸 σ* = √(ε_n·β*/γ) 只有十幾微米，兩束必須以微米精度對準。~A collider's output is set by luminosity: event rate = L×σ. For Gaussian beams with n_b bunches of N protons each, revolution frequency f_rev, normalized emittance ε_n and interaction-point beta function β*, L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F, where F is the geometric loss from the crossing angle. Luminosity grows with the square of the bunch population, so the injector chain must deliver bright bunches, while β* is squeezed to sub-metre values by the final triplet of superconducting quadrupoles. The beam size at the interaction point, σ* = √(ε_n·β*/γ), is only some tens of micrometres, so the two beams must be aligned to micrometre precision.
units.model: 取 N = 1.15×10¹¹、n_b = 2808、f_rev = 11,245 Hz、γ = 7461、ε_n = 3.75 µm、β* = 0.55 m、F = 0.84：L = (1.15×10¹¹)²×2808×11245×7461/(4π×3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹；σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 16.6 µm。代入時各項需使用一致單位，並記得交叉角幾何因子 F 會降低亮度，β* 越小此損失越明顯。~With N = 1.15×10¹¹, n_b = 2808, f_rev = 11,245 Hz, γ = 7461, ε_n = 3.75 µm, β* = 0.55 m and F = 0.84: L = (1.15×10¹¹)²×2808×11245×7461/(4π×3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹, and σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 16.6 µm. Insert every term in consistent units and remember that the crossing-angle geometric factor F reduces luminosity, a loss that grows as β* shrinks.
units.verify: 做 van der Meer 掃描：讓兩束在對撞點沿水平與垂直方向互相掃過，記錄事件率對位移的曲線，由曲線寬度得到有效束流重疊尺寸 Σ_x、Σ_y，再以 L = N₁N₂ n_b f_rev/(2πΣ_xΣ_y) 計算絕對亮度，與用發射度和 β* 算出的值比較，差異應在幾個百分點內。~Perform a van der Meer scan: sweep the two beams across each other horizontally and vertically at the interaction point, record event rate against displacement, obtain the effective overlap sizes Σ_x and Σ_y from the curve widths, compute the absolute luminosity as L = N₁N₂ n_b f_rev/(2πΣ_xΣ_y), and compare with the value predicted from emittance and β*, which should agree to within a few percent.
units.failure: 發射度在注入鏈或注入過程中膨脹一倍，亮度直接減半；若誤以為加大每團粒子數可以補回，束流與束流的交互作用會讓調諧值偏移、損失上升，最終反而縮短填充壽命。~If the emittance doubles in the injector chain or at injection, luminosity halves outright; trying to compensate with larger bunch populations drives beam-beam tune shifts and losses up and ultimately shortens the fill lifetime.
units.misconception: 亮度只跟束流能量有關，能量越高亮度越高。~Luminosity depends only on beam energy, so higher energy means higher luminosity.

units.anchor: NbTi 盧瑟福纜與雙孔徑冷質量~NbTi Rutherford cable and twin-aperture cold mass
units.title: 超導主偶極：線圈、預應力與淬火保護~Superconducting main dipoles: coils, pre-stress and quench protection
units.mechanism: 每顆主偶極是一個「二合一」磁鐵：兩個 56 mm 孔徑的 cos θ 線圈裝在同一個鐵軛與低溫恆溫槽內，產生方向相反的場讓兩束反向迴旋。線圈由 NbTi 細絲嵌在銅基體中的盧瑟福纜繞成內外兩層，以沃斯田鐵不銹鋼箍環施加預應力，避免 8.33 T 下的勞侖茲力讓導體微動發熱而淬火。一旦某處失去超導，淬火偵測器在毫秒內觸發加熱片使整個線圈均勻轉為常導，並由二極體把電流旁路，讓儲存的磁能分散在整顆磁鐵而不是燒毀一小段導體。~Each main dipole is a two-in-one magnet: two cos θ coils with 56 mm apertures share one iron yoke and cryostat and produce opposite fields so the two beams circulate in opposite directions. The coils are wound in two layers of Rutherford cable made of NbTi filaments in a copper matrix and are pre-stressed by austenitic stainless-steel collars so that the Lorentz forces at 8.33 T cannot let the conductor move and heat itself into a quench. When superconductivity is lost anywhere, quench detection fires heaters within milliseconds to drive the whole coil normal and a bypass diode diverts the current, so the stored magnetic energy is spread over the entire magnet instead of burning a short length of conductor.
units.model: 儲能 E = ½LI²：取單顆偶極電感 98.7 mH、I = 11,850 A，E = 0.5×0.0987×11850² ≈ 6.9 MJ，1232 顆合計約 8.5 GJ。磁壓 B²/(2μ₀) = 8.33²/(2×4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 27.6 MPa，相當於 276 bar 向外推線圈，這就是箍環預應力必須承受的量級。~Stored energy E = ½LI²: with a single-dipole inductance of 98.7 mH and I = 11,850 A, E = 0.5×0.0987×11850² ≈ 6.9 MJ, about 8.5 GJ for all 1232 dipoles. The magnetic pressure B²/(2μ₀) = 8.33²/(2×4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 27.6 MPa, equivalent to 276 bar pushing the coil outward, is the order of pre-stress the collars must hold.
units.verify: 在冷測站把每顆磁鐵升到額定電流以上並記錄淬火電流的「訓練」曲線，確認經幾次淬火後能穩定達到 8.33 T 以上；以旋轉線圈量測多極場分量（b₃、b₅ 以 10⁻⁴ 為單位），並量淬火時線圈的最高溫度與電壓，確認加熱片與二極體把熱點溫度限制在約 300 K 以下。~On the cold test bench ramp each magnet above nominal current and record the training curve of quench currents, confirming that after a few quenches it reliably exceeds 8.33 T; measure the multipole content (b₃, b₅ in units of 10⁻⁴) with rotating coils, and record the peak coil temperature and voltage during a quench to confirm that heaters and diodes keep the hot spot below about 300 K.
units.failure: 預應力不足時線圈在升流中發生微米級滑動，摩擦熱使局部超過臨界溫度而淬火；症狀是訓練淬火次數異常多且淬火電流不隨次數上升，整顆磁鐵必須退回重新裝配。~With insufficient pre-stress the coil slips by micrometres during the ramp, frictional heat pushes a spot above the critical temperature and the magnet quenches; the symptom is an abnormal number of training quenches whose current does not climb, and the magnet must be returned for reassembly.
units.misconception: 超導磁鐵一旦冷卻到工作溫度就不會再淬火。~Once cooled to operating temperature a superconducting magnet can no longer quench.

units.anchor: 1.9 K 超流氦熱交換管~1.9 K superfluid-helium heat-exchanger tube
units.title: 低溫系統：超流氦、熱負載與製冷功率~Cryogenics: superfluid helium, heat loads and refrigeration power
units.mechanism: LHC 把 NbTi 磁鐵冷到 1.9 K 而不是 4.2 K，因為臨界電流密度隨溫度下降而上升，讓同樣的導體在 8.33 T 仍有餘裕。低於 2.17 K 的氦成為超流氦 He II，有效熱導極高、黏度極低，能滲進線圈絕緣帶走熱量；每顆磁鐵的冷質量浸在 1.9 K、1.3 bar 的靜態 He II 中，熱量再經由穿過磁鐵的貝氏熱交換管傳給 16 mbar 的兩相飽和 He II。八座 4.5 K 製冷站各約 18 kW，加上 1.8 K 冷壓縮機單元，維持約 36,000 噸冷質量與 120 噸氦；束流造成的同步輻射、影像電流與電子雲熱負載則由 5 K 到 20 K 的束流屏截住，不進入 1.9 K。~The LHC cools its NbTi magnets to 1.9 K rather than 4.2 K because critical current density rises as temperature falls, giving the same conductor margin at 8.33 T. Below 2.17 K helium becomes superfluid He II, with enormous effective thermal conductivity and negligible viscosity, so it penetrates the coil insulation and carries heat away; each magnet's cold mass sits in static He II at 1.9 K and 1.3 bar, and heat passes to two-phase saturated He II at 16 mbar in a bayonet heat-exchanger tube running through the magnets. Eight 4.5 K refrigerators of about 18 kW each, plus 1.8 K cold-compressor units, hold roughly 36,000 tonnes of cold mass and 120 tonnes of helium; beam-induced loads from synchrotron radiation, image currents and electron cloud are intercepted by beam screens at 5 to 20 K so they never reach 1.9 K.
units.model: 卡諾比功 W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157；實際製冷機效率約卡諾的 20%，所以每瓦 1.9 K 熱負載約需 800 W 電力。若一個 3.3 km 扇區的 1.9 K 熱負載為 2.4 kW，電力約 1.9 MW，八個扇區約 15 MW，加上 4.5 K 與束流屏負載，總耗電量級為公開的 40 MW。~The Carnot work ratio W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157; real refrigerators reach about 20 percent of Carnot, so each watt at 1.9 K costs about 800 W of electricity. If one 3.3 km sector carries 2.4 kW at 1.9 K, that is about 1.9 MW, about 15 MW for eight sectors, and with the 4.5 K and beam-screen loads the total is of the order of the public 40 MW figure.
units.verify: 以熱平衡法量熱負載：關閉製冷供給一段時間，由 He II 槽的溫升速率乘以熱容得到靜態熱負載，與設計值（每公尺約零點幾瓦）比較；再用安裝在磁鐵上的 Cernox 溫度計與 16 mbar 管線的壓力計，確認整個扇區的溫度梯度小於 0.1 K。~Measure heat load by the thermal-balance method: interrupt refrigeration briefly and convert the warm-up rate of the He II bath, multiplied by its heat capacity, into the static load, comparing with the design value of a few tenths of a watt per metre; then use the Cernox thermometers on the magnets and the pressure gauges on the 16 mbar line to confirm that the temperature gradient along a sector stays below 0.1 K.
units.failure: 絕熱真空因洩漏劣化後，輻射與氣體導熱使熱負載倍增，製冷站無法維持 1.9 K，磁鐵溫度升到 2.2 K 以上失去超流，臨界電流下降，磁鐵在未達額定電流前就淬火。~When the insulation vacuum degrades through a leak, radiation and gas conduction multiply the heat load, the plant can no longer hold 1.9 K, the magnets warm above 2.2 K and lose superfluidity, the critical current drops and the magnets quench before reaching nominal current.
units.misconception: 冷到 4.2 K 已經是超導，再冷到 1.9 K 只是浪費電。~Superconducting at 4.2 K already, going to 1.9 K merely wastes electricity.

units.anchor: 束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型~Beam-position monitors and magnet field model
units.title: 軌道、光學量測與磁場校正~Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration
units.mechanism: 環上約一千組束流位置監測器（BPM）在每一圈量兩束的位置，軌道回授用數百顆校正磁鐵把閉軌壓到次毫米；調諧值由 BBQ 系統從束流的微小振盪頻譜讀出，色品度則以調變 RF 頻率、觀察調諧變化量測。光學函數 β 的誤差（β-beating）用 AC 偶極激發束流做逐圈量測再反解。超導磁鐵在注入能量 450 GeV 時持續電流會隨時間衰減、在升流開始時又「回彈」，改變六極場分量 b₃，因此必須以參考磁鐵的量測建立場模型，前饋修正六極校正磁鐵。~About a thousand beam-position monitors read both beams every turn and an orbit feedback uses hundreds of corrector magnets to hold the closed orbit to sub-millimetre; the tune is read by the BBQ system from the spectrum of tiny beam oscillations, and chromaticity is measured by modulating the RF frequency and watching the tune shift. Errors in the beta function (beta-beating) are measured turn by turn with an AC dipole exciting the beam and then inverted. In superconducting magnets at the 450 GeV injection energy, persistent currents decay with time and snap back when the ramp starts, changing the sextupole component b₃, so a field model built from reference-magnet measurements feeds corrections forward to the sextupole correctors.
units.model: 一顆偶極的彎轉角 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad；1 單位（10⁻⁴）的場誤差產生 0.51 µrad 的踢角。閉軌畸變峰值 ≈ θ√(β_i β_j)/(2 sin πQ)，取 β = 100 m、Q 的分數部分 0.31：0.51×10⁻⁶×100/(2×0.827) ≈ 31 µm。這是單顆磁鐵的量級，1232 顆隨機誤差則以均方根累加成毫米等級，必須校正。~One dipole bends by 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad, so a 1-unit (10⁻⁴) field error gives a 0.51 µrad kick. The peak closed-orbit distortion ≈ θ√(β_i β_j)/(2 sin πQ); with β = 100 m and a fractional tune of 0.31, 0.51×10⁻⁶×100/(2×0.827) ≈ 31 µm. That is one magnet; the random errors of 1232 dipoles add in quadrature to the millimetre level and must be corrected.
units.verify: 注入後比較 BPM 量到的閉軌與模型預測，用奇異值分解把校正磁鐵的響應矩陣反解，施加修正後確認軌道均方根小於 0.5 mm；在注入平台上每 100 s 量一次色品度，確認 b₃ 衰減的前饋修正把色品度維持在設定值 ±2 以內。~After injection compare the BPM closed orbit with the model, invert the corrector response matrix by singular-value decomposition, apply the correction and confirm an rms orbit below 0.5 mm; on the injection plateau measure chromaticity every 100 s and confirm that the feed-forward for b₃ decay keeps it within ±2 of the set value.
units.failure: 若回彈補償的時間模型錯誤，升流開始時色品度在幾秒內跳變數十單位，頭尾不穩定性被激發，束流損失觸發束流傾卸，整個填充作廢並損失數小時。~If the timing model of snapback compensation is wrong, chromaticity jumps by tens of units within seconds of the ramp starting, head-tail instabilities develop, beam losses trigger a dump and the whole fill is lost along with several hours.
units.misconception: 超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。~A superconducting magnet's field is set by current alone, independent of time and history.

units.anchor: 準直器顎板與束流損失監測器~Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors
units.title: 機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算~Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets
units.mechanism: 設計值下每束儲存 362 MJ，足以熔化約 700 kg 銅，而超導線圈只要吸收每立方公分數十毫焦的瞬間能量就會淬火，因此只有極小比例的束流可以在磁鐵附近損失。多級準直系統在 IR7 做橫向清除、IR3 做動量清除：主準直器以碳纖維複合材料顎板放在約 5 到 6 倍束流尺寸處攔截暈粒子，次級準直器與吸收器再接住散射產物，清除效率須達 99.99% 以上。環上約四千個游離室束流損失監測器以 40 µs 到 1.3 s 的多個時間窗持續積分，任何通道超過閾值就在三圈內觸發束流傾卸：踢磁鐵在 3 µs 的空檔中把束流引出，掃過 7 m 長的石墨傾卸塊分散能量。~At design values each beam stores 362 MJ, enough to melt about 700 kg of copper, while a superconducting coil quenches after absorbing only tens of millijoules per cubic centimetre in a fast loss, so only a tiny fraction of the beam may be lost near magnets. A multi-stage collimation system cleans the betatron halo in IR7 and the momentum halo in IR3: primary collimators with carbon-fibre-composite jaws at about 5 to 6 beam sigmas intercept halo particles, secondary collimators and absorbers catch the scattered products, and the cleaning efficiency must exceed 99.99 percent. Some four thousand ionization-chamber beam-loss monitors integrate over several windows from 40 µs to 1.3 s, and any channel above threshold triggers a beam dump within three turns: kicker magnets extract the beam during a 3 µs gap and sweep it over a 7 m graphite dump block to spread the energy.
units.model: 束流能量 = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J。銅從 300 K 升到熔點並熔化約需 505 kJ/kg，362 MJ 可熔化約 717 kg。若快速損失 10⁹ 個 7 TeV 質子（1.1 kJ）就可能淬火一顆磁鐵，這相當於束流的 3×10⁻⁶，所以準直系統的洩漏率必須遠低於 10⁻⁵。~Beam energy = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J. Heating copper from 300 K to its melting point and melting it takes about 505 kJ/kg, so 362 MJ melts about 717 kg. If a fast loss of 10⁹ protons at 7 TeV (1.1 kJ) can quench a magnet, that is 3×10⁻⁶ of the beam, so the collimation leakage must stay far below 10⁻⁵.
units.verify: 做損失圖（loss map）：以橫向激發刻意讓束流暈增長，記錄環上每個束流損失監測器的讀數，確認最高損失集中在準直區且冷區的損失低於準直區峰值的 10⁻⁵；另外以低強度束流測試傾卸系統，核對踢磁鐵的同步與傾卸塊上的束流掃描軌跡。~Produce loss maps: deliberately grow the beam halo with transverse excitation, record every beam-loss monitor around the ring, and confirm that losses peak in the collimation regions while cold-region losses stay below 10⁻⁵ of that peak; separately test the dump system with low-intensity beam, checking kicker synchronization and the swept beam trace on the dump block.
units.failure: 準直器顎板若因對準誤差退到 8 σ 以外，暈粒子直接打到三合一四極磁鐵，束流損失監測器在數毫秒內超過閾值而傾卸束流；若監測器閾值設定過高，則磁鐵淬火、扇區升溫，恢復需數天。~If a misaligned collimator jaw retreats beyond 8 σ, halo particles strike the triplet quadrupoles directly and the beam-loss monitors exceed threshold within milliseconds and dump the beam; if the thresholds were set too high instead, a magnet quenches, the sector warms up and recovery takes days.
units.misconception: 束流管內是真空，損失的質子不會造成任何傷害。~The beam pipe is a vacuum, so lost protons do no harm.

units.anchor: 注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統~Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system
units.title: 注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合~Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration
units.mechanism: 質子由 Linac4 的 160 MeV H⁻ 經 PS Booster 2 GeV、PS 26 GeV、SPS 450 GeV 逐級加速，SPS 分 12 批注入每個環，填滿約需 4 分 20 秒。每束由 4 個低溫模組內的 8 個 400.8 MHz 超導腔提供每腔 2 MV、共 16 MV 的電壓；這個電壓主要用來建立縱向的「桶」把粒子束縛成 1 ns 左右的團，真正的加速增量很小。升流時偶極電流從約 760 A 升到 11,850 A 約需 20 分鐘，RF 頻率隨速度微調，之後把 β* 從注入的 11 m 壓縮到 0.55 m 並把兩束對撞。~Protons from Linac4 at 160 MeV (as H⁻) are accelerated in turn by the PS Booster to 2 GeV, the PS to 26 GeV and the SPS to 450 GeV; the SPS injects 12 batches into each ring and filling takes about 4 minutes 20 seconds. Each beam is driven by 8 superconducting 400.8 MHz cavities in 4 cryomodules at 2 MV each, 16 MV in total; this voltage mainly builds the longitudinal bucket that confines particles into bunches of about 1 ns, and the actual acceleration increment is tiny. During the ramp the dipole current rises from about 760 A to 11,850 A in roughly 20 minutes while the RF frequency tracks the velocity, after which β* is squeezed from 11 m at injection to 0.55 m and the beams are brought into collision.
units.model: 諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640；25 ns 的團間距等於 10 個 RF 桶，所以最多 3564 個團，注入踢磁鐵與傾卸空檔使實際上限為 2808。升流 20 分鐘內能量增加 6.55 TeV，每圈只需 6.55×10¹²/(1200×11,245) ≈ 0.49 MeV，遠小於 16 MV 的 RF 電壓。~Harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640; a 25 ns bunch spacing equals 10 RF buckets, so at most 3564 bunches, and the injection-kicker and dump gaps reduce the practical limit to 2808. Over a 20-minute ramp the energy rises by 6.55 TeV, requiring only 6.55×10¹²/(1200×11,245) ≈ 0.49 MeV per turn, far below the 16 MV RF voltage.
units.verify: 以壁電流監測器量團的縱向輪廓與長度，確認注入時 SPS 與 LHC 的 RF 相位同步使團落在桶中心、注入後無縱向振盪；升流中記錄束流流強與發射度，確認損失小於 1% 且發射度膨脹小於 10%。~Measure bunch profiles and lengths with a wall-current monitor, confirming that SPS and LHC RF phases are synchronized at injection so bunches land at bucket centre without longitudinal oscillation; during the ramp log intensity and emittance to confirm losses below 1 percent and emittance growth below 10 percent.
units.failure: 注入時 RF 相位誤差幾度，團在桶內做大幅同步振盪，部分粒子溢出桶外成為未被捕獲的「幽靈」電荷，在傾卸空檔中被踢磁鐵部分偏轉而損失在孔徑上，觸發保護系統。~A phase error of a few degrees at injection makes the bunches execute large synchrotron oscillations, some particles spill out of the bucket as uncaptured ghost charge, get partially deflected by the kickers in the dump gap and are lost on the aperture, triggering the protection system.
units.misconception: 16 MV 的 RF 電壓是用來把質子從 450 GeV 加速到 7 TeV 的主要動力。~The 16 MV of RF is the main power that accelerates protons from 450 GeV to 7 TeV.

units.anchor: 硬體試運轉與電路驗收表~Hardware commissioning and circuit acceptance sheet
units.title: 硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接~Hardware commissioning, splice resistance and operations handoff
units.mechanism: 冷卻完成後，每一個超導電路都要經過電氣品質保證（絕緣、接地、儀器線路）、淬火保護系統測試，再逐步升流到額定值並記錄訓練淬火；主偶極電路由 154 顆磁鐵串聯，匯流排接頭以軟焊連接，每個接頭的電阻必須在 nΩ 等級，否則焦耳熱會在失去超導時引發熱失控，這正是 2008 年 9 月事故的機制。束流試運轉再從第一圈、RF 捕獲、升流、壓縮到對撞逐步解鎖，每一步都有機器保護檢查表；交接給操作團隊的文件包括每個電路的訓練歷史、接頭電阻量測、損失監測器閾值表與亮度校正結果。~After cool-down every superconducting circuit passes electrical quality assurance (insulation, grounding, instrumentation wiring) and quench-protection tests, then is ramped stepwise to nominal while training quenches are logged; a main-dipole circuit strings 154 magnets in series with soldered bus-bar splices whose resistance must stay at the nanoohm level, otherwise Joule heating after loss of superconductivity drives thermal runaway, which is exactly the mechanism of the September 2008 incident. Beam commissioning then unlocks first turn, RF capture, ramp, squeeze and collisions in turn, each step gated by a machine-protection checklist; the handoff package to operations contains every circuit's training history, splice-resistance measurements, loss-monitor threshold tables and luminosity-calibration results.
units.model: 接頭功率 P = I²R：I = 11,850 A 時，R = 1 nΩ 給 0.14 W，可由 He II 帶走；R = 220 nΩ 則為 31 W，遠超局部冷卻能力，銅穩定層會在數秒內升溫到失去超導並電弧。因此驗收標準把接頭電阻上限訂在數 nΩ，整個電路 1232 顆磁鐵的接頭總電阻也只有微歐等級。~Splice power P = I²R: at I = 11,850 A, R = 1 nΩ gives 0.14 W, which He II removes easily, whereas R = 220 nΩ gives 31 W, far beyond local cooling, so the copper stabilizer warms within seconds, loses superconductivity and arcs. Acceptance therefore caps splice resistance at a few nanoohms, and the total splice resistance of a 1232-magnet circuit is only at the microohm level.
units.verify: 在 1.9 K 用高精度電壓量測在接頭兩端讀取電壓降，除以電流得到 nΩ 級電阻，與 1 nΩ 等級的驗收上限比較；室溫下再用量測銅穩定層連續性的方法檢查每個接頭的焊接品質，所有數據存入電路資料庫並在交接前由機器保護小組簽核。~At 1.9 K read the voltage drop across each splice with high-resolution voltmeters and divide by the current to obtain the nanoohm resistance, comparing with the acceptance limit of the order of 1 nΩ; at room temperature check the soldering quality of each splice by measuring the continuity of the copper stabilizer, and store all data in the circuit database for sign-off by the machine-protection team before handoff.
units.failure: 一個未被量到的高電阻接頭在升流到額定電流時過熱、電弧並擊穿氦槽，數噸氦瞬間汽化造成壓力波，把數十顆磁鐵推離定位，修復需一年以上；這就是為何接頭量測與升壓洩放閥成為驗收的必要項目。~A single unmeasured high-resistance splice overheats on the ramp to nominal current, arcs and breaches the helium enclosure, several tonnes of helium vaporize at once and the pressure wave shoves dozens of magnets off their supports, with repairs taking more than a year; this is why splice measurements and enlarged relief valves became mandatory acceptance items.
units.misconception: 每顆磁鐵都在測試站通過驗收，整個電路就不需要再量接頭。~If every magnet passed its bench test, the assembled circuit needs no splice measurement.

example: 亮度與事件率練習：取每團 N = 1.15×10¹¹ 個質子、n_b = 2808 團、f_rev = 11,245 Hz、γ = 7461、ε_n = 3.75 µm、β* = 0.55 m、交叉角因子 F = 0.84。對撞點束流尺寸 σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 1.66×10⁻⁵ m = 16.6 µm。亮度 L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F = 1.3225×10²²×2808×11245×7461/(2.59×10⁻⁵)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹。取非彈性截面 σ_inel = 80 mb = 8×10⁻²⁶ cm²，事件率 = L×σ = 8×10⁸ 次/秒；每秒交叉次數 = 2808×11,245 = 3.16×10⁷，所以每次交叉平均約 25 個事件（堆疊）。一小時的積分亮度 = 1.0×10³⁴×3600 = 3.6×10³⁷ cm⁻² = 36 pb⁻¹。束流儲存能量 = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7×10¹² eV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ = 362 MJ。數值為設計參數等級的教學假設，不代表任何特定運轉填充。~Luminosity and event-rate exercise: take N = 1.15×10¹¹ protons per bunch, n_b = 2808 bunches, f_rev = 11,245 Hz, γ = 7461, ε_n = 3.75 µm, β* = 0.55 m and a crossing-angle factor F = 0.84. The beam size at the interaction point is σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 1.66×10⁻⁵ m = 16.6 µm. The luminosity L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F = 1.3225×10²²×2808×11245×7461/(2.59×10⁻⁵)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹. With an inelastic cross-section σ_inel = 80 mb = 8×10⁻²⁶ cm², the event rate is L×σ = 8×10⁸ per second; crossings per second are 2808×11,245 = 3.16×10⁷, so each crossing carries about 25 events on average (pile-up). One hour integrates 1.0×10³⁴×3600 = 3.6×10³⁷ cm⁻² = 36 pb⁻¹. The stored beam energy is 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7×10¹² eV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ = 362 MJ. Values are teaching assumptions at the level of design parameters, not any particular operating fill.
history: LHC 於 1994 年獲 CERN 理事會核准，建在 1989 到 2000 年運轉的 LEP 正負電子對撞機留下的 26.7 km 隧道中，以 1.9 K 超流氦冷卻的 NbTi 雙孔徑磁鐵達到 LEP 隧道半徑下所需的 8.33 T。2008 年 9 月 10 日首次有束流循環，九天後一個匯流排接頭電阻過高引發電弧與氦洩漏，修復一年後於 2009 年底重新啟動；2012 年 7 月 ATLAS 與 CMS 宣布發現希格斯玻色子，Run 2（2015–2018）在 6.5 TeV 運轉，Run 3 自 2022 年起以 6.8 TeV 達到 13.6 TeV 的對撞能量。高亮度 LHC 升級將以 Nb₃Sn 四極磁鐵與蟹形腔把亮度再提高五倍以上。本課只重建公開的設計原理與工程邏輯。~The LHC was approved by the CERN Council in 1994 and built in the 26.7 km tunnel left by the LEP electron-positron collider that ran from 1989 to 2000, using twin-aperture NbTi magnets cooled by 1.9 K superfluid helium to reach the 8.33 T demanded by the LEP tunnel radius. Beam first circulated on 10 September 2008; nine days later a bus-bar splice with excessive resistance arced and released helium, and after a year of repairs the machine restarted at the end of 2009. ATLAS and CMS announced the Higgs boson in July 2012, Run 2 (2015–2018) operated at 6.5 TeV, and Run 3 from 2022 reaches 13.6 TeV collisions at 6.8 TeV per beam. The High-Luminosity LHC upgrade will raise luminosity by more than a factor of five with Nb₃Sn quadrupoles and crab cavities. This course reconstructs only public design principles and engineering logic.
